title: Resolution urging Albany to allow rolling deadlines for tax breaks
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature and Governor to pass legislation allowing a rolling application deadline in New York City for the disability homeowner exemption and senior citizen homeowner exemption. Currently applicants must apply by a fixed March 15 deadline, which the Council says limits how many eligible people with disabilities and older adults can receive the property tax breaks. Both exemptions can reduce property taxes by up to 50 percent for qualifying homeowners earning $58,399 or less.
